CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_TASK_START] @task_name [varchar](30),@pipeline_runid [VARCHAR](36),@data_layer [nvarchar](150),@process_date [datetime] AS

BEGIN

    --DECLARE @FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
	--
	--SELECT
	--@FLAG_CNT=COUNT(*)
	--FROM 
	--	[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
	--INNER JOIN
	--	[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS	
	--	ON
	--	OTR.STATUS_ID=OS.STATUS_ID
	--WHERE
	--	OTR.TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name) AND
	--	OTR.PROCESS_DATE = @process_date AND 
	--	OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
	--	
	--IF(@FLAG_CNT>0)
	--  BEGIN
	--	   --PRINT('JOB WAS ALREADY EXECUTED SUCCESSFULLY, SKIPPING EXECUTION')
	--	   RAISERROR('JOB %s WAS ALREADY EXECUTED SUCCESSFULLY, SKIPPING EXECUTION', 16,1,@task_name)
	--
	--  END

	--IF(@FLAG_CNT=0)
	   BEGIN
			DELETE
			FROM 
				[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
			WHERE
				TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name) AND
				PROCESS_DATE = @process_date AND
				STATUS_ID <> (SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL')
				
		   ---START TASK
			INSERT INTO 
			[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
			(
				TASK_RUN_ID,
				TASK_NAME,
				PIPELINE_RUNID,
				STATUS_ID,
				DATA_LAYER,
				PROCESS_DATE,
				START_DATETIME,
				END_DATETIME,
				CREATE_DATETIME
			)
			SELECT  
				 concat(@pipeline_runid,'-',UPPER(@task_name))
				,UPPER(@task_name)
				,@pipeline_runid
				,(SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'RUNNING')
				,UPPER(@data_layer)
				,@process_date
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
				,NULL
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)		
	   END
	
END
GO
